name: Boutiq | 2g Liquid Diamond Disposable | Orange Slush + Mango Runtz + Guava Gelato
description: Three tanks. One device. Zero compromise. The Boutiq Switch V5 puts a built-in selector dial under your thumb, letting you cycle between three distinct strain profiles inside a single 2G aluminum chassis. Each tank is filled with Liquid Live Diamonds across all three chambers, with indica, sativa, and hybrid profiles mapped so your session matches your mood without reaching for a second device.
